title: White House withdrew Heidi Overton’s FDA nomination, AP reports
summary: The White House told AP it had withdrawn Heidi Overton’s nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration. A senior administration official told Axios that Overton lacked sufficient support on Capitol Hill for confirmation and that the administration wanted a new direction at the FDA. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: A senior administration official.
The White House said it had pulled the nomination.

responses.who: Senior administration official, speaking to Axios
responses.text: The official said Overton lacked sufficient support on Capitol Hill for confirmation and that the administration needed a new direction at the FDA.

title: AP calls Alaska Senate race for Mary Peltola; CBS News independently projects her victory
summary: The Associated Press called Alaska’s U.S. Senate race for Democrat Mary Peltola over Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan, and CBS News independently projected her victory. Peltola said in a statement reported by AP that voters had signaled dissatisfaction with the status quo in DC. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: AP race call based on election results.
CBS News says it independently projects Peltola's victory. The available article was updated at 03:47 UTC.
NBC News made its own election projection; the article URL was identified through a separate election reference, but the article itself was inaccessible.

responses.text: In a statement reported by AP, Peltola said voters had signaled that the status quo in DC was not working for Alaska.

title: AP reports Iran war disruptions to regional sport as Qatar and Abu Dhabi F1 races remain scheduled
summary: The Associated Press reported that the Iran war has disrupted major sporting events across the Middle East. In an interview with The National, FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem said the federation was prepared for the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Formula 1 races to proceed. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: AP reporting and interviews with regional and sports researchers, including an analyst at the International Institute for Strategic Studies.
Exclusive interview with FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem.
Reports FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem's public statement and the disruption to earlier regional races.

Interviews Middle East researcher Kristian Ulrichsen and sports professor Simon Chadwick about disruption to regional events; says the Qatar and Abu Dhabi races remain scheduled but their staging is uncertain.

responses.text: Told The National that the FIA was ready and fully prepared for the Qatar and Abu Dhabi races to proceed.

title: Reuters reports global stocks slipped as investors weighed Nvidia’s forecast
summary: Reuters reported that global stocks slipped Wednesday as investors assessed Nvidia’s sales forecast and awaited Anthropic’s market debut. Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion and forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Market data and company forecasts; Reuters also cites market participants.
AFP reports market movements and Nvidia’s results and quotes market analysts.
Bloomberg reports market data and describes Anthropic as having told prospective investors it expects to price shares at the high end of its range or above.

responses.text: Nvidia reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion and forecast fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%. Interim CEO Colette Kress said the company’s momentum was real and its product roadmap was on track.

title: AP: Garcia sends preservation letters ahead of planned House investigations into Trump administration
summary: AP reported that Representative Robert Garcia sent document-preservation letters to members of President Donald Trump's family and senior officials ahead of planned House investigations into the administration. White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis told WIRED that the president was willing to work with anyone to deliver results, while criticizing the proposed Democratic investigations. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Letters released Wednesday and a statement from Garcia.
Describes and quotes multiple letters from Garcia, including their recipients and requests.
Describes and quotes Garcia's letters and obtained responses directly from a White House spokeswoman and a World Liberty spokesperson.

responses.text: Told WIRED that the president was willing to work with anyone to deliver results, but said Democrats pursuing investigations she characterized as shams would be working against the American people.
Told WIRED that congressional scrutiny of a company he described as compliant would be troubling without a basis.
WIRED reported that the representative did not immediately respond to its request for comment.

title: Sanders tells AP he plans Medicare expansion push if Democrats control Senate
summary: According to AP, Sen. Bernie Sanders plans to pursue Medicare for All when Democrats control the Senate, beginning with lowering Medicare eligibility to 55 and expanding benefits. NBC separately reported remarks by Sanders and Hakeem Jeffries on lowering the eligibility age and expanding coverage. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Exclusive interview with Sanders.
Reports Sanders' post-election call for Democrats to pass Medicare for All and quotes his proposed first steps.
Reports remarks by Hakeem Jeffries and Sanders on lowering the Medicare age and expanding benefits.

responses.text: In a statement published by his Senate office, Sanders called for Medicare eligibility at 55, dental, vision and hearing benefits, and guaranteed health care for children as initial steps toward Medicare for All.

title: TJX revenue exceeds estimates as company raises annual comparable-sales forecast, Reuters reports
summary: TJX reported third-quarter revenue above analysts’ estimates and raised its full-year comparable-sales forecast, according to Reuters. In its earnings release, TJX reported net sales of $15.952 billion and said CEO Ernie Herrman expected sales momentum to accelerate during the holiday season. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: TJX results and analyst estimates compiled by LSEG
Reports company results and analyst estimates from a Zacks Investment Research survey; the story was generated by Automated Insights using Zacks data.
Compares reported revenue with the Zacks Consensus Estimate.

responses.text: In TJX's earnings release, Herrman said sales, profitability and earnings exceeded company expectations and that he expected sales momentum to accelerate during the holiday season.

title: Witnesses tell Reuters Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza
summary: Witnesses told Reuters that Israeli tanks advanced beyond the Yellow Line in central Gaza on Wednesday. The Israeli military said the operation targeted Hamas infrastructure, while Hamas called the raid and evacuation a ceasefire violation, Reuters reported. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Israeli civilian-military agency COGAT's statement and Palestinian media reports
Witnesses, Palestinian medics and an Israeli military spokesperson

responses.text: Said the operation targeted Hamas infrastructure west of the Yellow Line, according to Reuters.
Called the raid and evacuation a violation of the ceasefire, according to Reuters.

title: Forbes reports Xint found five NGINX flaws; NGINX announces security updates
summary: Forbes reported that Xint found five NGINX vulnerabilities, including one that could permit remote code execution without authentication, and that F5 confirmed the findings. The NGINX project announced versions 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 with vulnerability fixes in its [release notice](https://nginx.org/2026.html). The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Interview with Xint CEO Brian Pak and confirmation from NGINX maintainer F5.
Reports the disclosures by Xint and other research teams, including Wiz, and cites their published findings and vulnerability databases.

responses.text: Forbes reported that F5 confirmed the five flaws and said it was patching them.
Announced versions 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 with fixes for multiple vulnerabilities.

title: Broward declared a local emergency after flooding, Axios and WLRN report
summary: Axios and WLRN reported that Broward County declared a local state of emergency following heavy rain and flooding. County administrator Monica Cepero’s declaration cited flooding and forecasts of further dangerous conditions, while Hollywood officials said crews were responding with high-water vehicles and urged residents to avoid flooded roads. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: Reports the county declaration and includes photographs by an Axios journalist of flooding in Hollywood.
Reports the county declaration and quotes a news release advising drivers to avoid flooded roads.
Reports the county and city declarations and cites National Weather Service rainfall estimates, a city advisory and a Florida Public Radio Emergency Network meteorologist.

responses.text: Declared a local state of emergency throughout Broward County, citing flooding and forecasts of further dangerous conditions.
Said emergency crews were responding with high-water vehicles and advised residents to avoid flooded roads.
